test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_insert_perf ( a Array(UInt64), pos_signed Int64, pos_unsigned UInt64, value UInt64 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_insert_perf SELECT arrayMap(i -> number + i, range(32)), toInt64(number % 33 + 1), number % 33 + 1, number FROM numbers(1000000)
test.query: SELECT arrayInsert(a, 17, value) FROM array_insert_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayConcat(arraySlice(a, 1, 16), [value], arraySlice(a, 17)) FROM array_insert_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayInsert(a, pos_signed, value) FROM array_insert_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayConcat(arraySlice(a, 1, pos_signed - 1), [value], arraySlice(a, pos_signed)) FROM array_insert_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayInsert(a, pos_unsigned, value) FROM array_insert_perf FORMAT Null
